token_budget_status: Not applicable to B0; must fix tokenizer budget before LLM use
pair_policy: earliest valid pre + latest valid post; if no pre/post, earliest/latest observed numeric pair; earliest unequal adjacent time-ordered state pair; no initial state

questions.Q1: What network activities, command requests and responses were observed?
questions.Q2: What process/electrical values and changes were reported?
questions.Q3: Which observed assets/channels/endpoints are involved and which mappings are unknown?
questions.Q5: What temporal associations between N/E are supported, without causality?
questions.Q6: Which security-relevant observations warrant investigation and what interpretation is supported?
questions.Q7: What cannot be concluded and what support is missing?

retrieval_selection: N request-first atomic m+a; complete gap; N round-robin. EN nearest later valid same-asset E per retrieved request then E family round-robin. E-only family round-robin.
experimental_caveat: EN retrieval changed as part of this amendment. Compare under v2 only; this is not measured fusion superiority or an LLM effect.
